articles.title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
articles.snippet: The law enforcement association said it has pivoted its position regarding the Clarity Act to neutral, months after it warned against a law it said would shield crypto crime.

articles.title: IMF confirms El Salvador’s bitcoin growth was funded by private donations, not public money
articles.snippet: The IMF confirmed that all bitcoin added to official holdings since June 2025 was sourced from private donations, with no public funds used for accumulation.

articles.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

articles.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
articles.snippet: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

articles.title: US law enforcement group moves to ‘neutral’ position on CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Despite earlier opposition to the CLARITY Act over consumer protection, the National Sheriffs’ Association says it will now “step back and allow the legislative process to proceed.“
